rationale: Accept remaining closeout work only. Original implementation chronology is explicitly not reconstructed. No new architecture or research authority is needed.

dimensions.problem_solution_fit: Completing the missing receipts addresses the actual remaining integration gate; it does not rebuild the control.
dimensions.alternatives: A redesign has no demonstrated benefit and conflicts with the owner request; retain the existing architecture.
dimensions.architecture_tradeoffs: Shared exact core avoids divergence; separate legacy and plan-first pins preserve old packages.
dimensions.complexity: Limit changes to closeout evidence and demonstrated defects; no runtime service.
dimensions.security_compliance: No private Knowledge Core body is published; references only. No DB access, providers or recipe datasets.
dimensions.cost: Existing subscription and required normal CI; no recurring service or exploratory CI loop.
dimensions.failure_scenarios: Changed head/base/roadmap invalidates review; missing CI holds merge; source mismatch must fail closed.
dimensions.acceptance_criteria: PIN, BOUNDARIES and REVIEW map to frozen files and local/CI evidence. Merge verification follows separately.
dimensions.roadmap_alignment: Exact acquisition roadmap, prior authorized lane isolation and current owner closeout mandate agree; no source admission authority is added.
